P4.outcome: inconclusive (unresolved: >= 100 at k = 80, 256; the G2 action gate at k = 160 is exploratory, so its ratio is exploratory)
P4.note: the support criterion needs all three k. At k = 160 the G2 action gate (d_R) comes from the exploratory replacement checker (D9), so the k = 160 ratio is exploratory; it also lies between the support and contradiction thresholds (D12). All application timings (every k, every operator) are used as recorded under G4: none exceeded 5 %, the k = 160 stencil timings carry the 1-5 % flag. G4 cannot establish foreign activity during any application timing, which lasts far less than its 10 s sampling interval (D6); this caveat applies equally to P4 and P5a and to every k. The k = 160 stencil timings are also slower per element than at k = 256, cause not established (D11).

P5a.outcome: inconclusive (unresolved: <= 1.15 at k = 80, 256; no confirmatory G2 action gate at k = 160, where the first checker run spilled and its replacement is exploratory)
P5a.note: plan 5.2 requires <= 1.15 at every k. The system-identity gate is applied as in P3a; at k = 160 it rests on the exploratory replacement checker (D9), so the k = 160 ratio is exploratory (listed). Same timing records and standard as P4. All application timings (every k, every operator) are used as recorded under G4: none exceeded 5 %, the k = 160 stencil timings carry the 1-5 % flag. G4 cannot establish foreign activity during any application timing, which lasts far less than its 10 s sampling interval (D6); this caveat applies equally to P4 and P5a and to every k. P5b.note: ratio = repaired / original solve time (medians). The contradiction is decided by the k = 80 mgir ratio, which lies far below the band with disjoint IQRs (the original-stencil IR needed more outer steps). The confirmatory mg64 ratios (k = 80, 256) lie inside the +/-15 % band. The k = 160 mg64 ratio is exploratory: its action check comes from the exploratory replacement checker (D9), outside the system-identity gate, which is applied as in P3a and P5a. No mgir ratio exists at k = 160 and 256, where the original-stencil IR breaks down (P8). The band tests equal cost within +/-15 %; it is not a statement that the repair costs nothing.

P6.outcome: inconclusive (the recorded process peaks retain workspaces of two builds, D14)
P6.note: The recorded values are process-life peaks as defined, but they do not measure one solve: in our H3 processes the timing wrapper kept the first build's preconditioner and multigrid hierarchy alive while the history pass built a second one (plus the history buffer, 8 bytes per DOF); in Hou's H3 process the driver kept a survivor index while their CG built its own. Subtracting the history buffer does not recover a single-solve value. Single-build, single-solve peaks were re-measured as EXPLORATORY runs (out/X_MEM_*.json, hou_exploratory.csv).
